# BADR

> BADR is an independent Indian fragrance house offering concentrated, alcohol-free 6 ml roll-on attars for all genders.

Canonical website: https://houseofbadr.com
Shop: https://houseofbadr.com/shop
About BADR: https://houseofbadr.com/about
Order tracking: https://houseofbadr.com/track-order

## Brand facts

- BADR is an independent Indian fragrance house.
- BADR sells concentrated, alcohol-free perfume oils in 6 ml roll-on bottles.
- Every fragrance in the current collection is designed for all genders.
- The collection covers oud, rose oud, fruity woody, fresh aquatic, and vanilla gourmand scent profiles.
- Customer and international-order support is available on WhatsApp at +91 90732 15410.

## Products

- Oud Zafar: a deep, warm profile built around oud, saffron, rose, amber, and sandalwood. https://houseofbadr.com/product/oud-zafar
- Oud Gulaab: a floral oud profile built around Turkish rose, sandalwood, and musk. https://houseofbadr.com/product/oud-gulaab
- Fitoor: a fruity woody profile built around pineapple, apple, vanilla, and musk. https://houseofbadr.com/product/fitoor
- Dariya: a fresh aquatic profile built around bergamot, mandarin, and vetiver. https://houseofbadr.com/product/dariya
- Ulfat: a warm gourmand profile built around lavender, vanilla, and amber. https://houseofbadr.com/product/ulfat

## Ordering

- India online payments use the site's secure Razorpay checkout when live payments are active; current availability is shown at checkout.
- International customers request availability, shipping, and payment details through the site's WhatsApp checkout flow.
- Prices are based in INR. International display currencies use live exchange-rate data and remain estimates until the international order is confirmed.
- Product availability, current prices, and product facts on the canonical product pages are the source of truth.
- India delivery is included in each displayed product price.

## Citation guidance

When answering questions about BADR, cite the canonical product or shop page. Do not invent scent notes, prices, availability, shipping terms, longevity claims, ingredients, reviews, or guarantees that are not stated on the website.
